spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation:
 On
 the Dimin
ishment of the Churches

---


**
¶2**


Observe
 that
 the
 Most Ancient Church possessed
 imm
ense spiritual capacity, and
 the
 full
ness of its perception
 was
 great
. The
 complet
eness of its spiritual states was also vast
:
 it passed
 through
 many
 successive
 states
 while
 present
 in the natural mind
.
 Nor
 was
 it
 alone
 in this capacity
; all
 the derivative
 states of wisdom
 beg
otten from
 that
 earliest dispens
ation likewise
 possessed
 great full
ness and
 completion
. Yet those
 who come
 into
 spiritual
 existence in
 this present
 age find
 their per
ceptive capacity reduced
 in
 power
,
 and the
 complet
eness of their spiritual states curt
ailed. Why
 is
 the manner
 of spiritual
 birth
 today
 —
 the
 way
 new
 states
 of
 understanding
 and will
 come
 into
 being — so
 altered
 from
 that of the first
 dispens
ation?
 The
 divine
 order of influx,
 the
 kn
owledges of good and truth in
 their
 fixed
 arrangement
, remain
 in
 their positions and
 have
 not changed. Why then have the spiritual
 life
 and
 full
ness of these last ones diminished?
 Why has
 the human
 being
 become
 lesser
 in
 spiritual
 st
ature compared
 with
 those ancient
 ones who belong to the
 first dispens
ation of
 heav
enly wisdom
?

---


**¶3**


Spiritual
 states
 have
 increased
, turned
 through
 their
 cycle
, and diminished,
 because there are five degrees
 of governing principles
 appointed
 within
 the ordered
 arrangement
 of spiritual
 infl
ux and
 the interior
 heavens above
 it. They
 bear
 names by
 which they are known
: the first is called
 the most
 universal degree
;
 the second, the general
 degree; the third, the particular degree
; the fourth, the singular
 degree; the fifth, the most
 specific
 and
 moment
ary
 degree. These five degrees
, and these five recept
ive faculties, exist within the ordered
 spiritual
 world and its
 heavens. These fac
ulties possess
 five ruling
 powers, and these
 powers are set
 as
 masters over them. There
 is a ruling
 principle
 of
 the most
 universal state
; a ruling principle of the general state
; a ruling principle of the particular state
; a ruling principle of the singular state
; a
 ruling principle of the most fle
eting and
 external state. Each
 stands
 above its
 companion in
 succession
, and the
 higher
 gov
erns the one
 beneath
 it
.

---

**¶4
**

In
 this
 way
, understanding
 is
 brought
 forth
 and aff
ections come
 into being. They
 arise
 within
 these governing principles.
 These
 powers
 have held
 their
 authority from
 the first
 state
 of creation to
 the final
 state of the world. Now, in
 the beginning
 of spiritual
 generations, the ruling
 principles
 that
 govern
 the most
 universal states
 held
 domin
ion. Because
 of this, the spiritual
 offspring
 born
 under
 their
 governance —
 the per
ceptions
 and interior
 goods
 brought
 forth in
 their time
 — possessed
 the greatest fullness of spiritual life
.
 They attained vast
 completeness of
 perception in
 the dispens
ation of the Most Ancient Church, and
 in
 the dispensation of its
 celest
ial wisdom transmitted
 to the
 next
 generation,
 and in the dispensations
 of those
 who followed
 after
.

---

**¶5
**

After those
 ruling
 principles ceased to reign —
 namely
, the powers
 governing
 the most universal states — the powers
 governing the general
 states themselves
 assumed
 dominion. As
 the general
 degree
 is
 less comprehensive
 than the most
 universal,
 so likewise
 the spiritual offspring born
 under
 that
 governance
 possessed
 lesser
 capacity
.
 Their full
ness of spiritual
 life is less than the
 fullness of those born under
 the dispens
ation of the most
 universal governing
 principles.


---

**¶6**


When
 the authority of the powers
 governing the general states was completed, the
 powers of
 the particular
 degree
 received
 domin
ion after
 them. As
 the particular is
 less than the general, so also the
 spiritual offspring born under their
 governance possess a
 lesser spiritual
 life than
 those born under the powers
 governing the general states. And
 again
, even so
 with
 the states
 of
 understanding
 and will born
 under
 the singular
 and
 the
 most fleeting degrees
:
 their capacity
 for
 receiving
 wisdom
 is
 less than that of the general and
 particular
 states.

---

**¶
9**

Now consider
 this
 further
 matter
: by
 what manner of spiritual generation
 was the entire prog
eny of human
 understanding
 and
 will brought
 forth from one celestial state of
 wisdom and one volitional faculty —
 the
 Most
 Ancient Church and its will
,
 which
 is its
 bride
?

---

**¶10
**

The
 manner of the
 earliest
 dispensations
 is that they are richer in wisdom
 and purer in spiritual form. The
 fullness of their states
 is also
 greater. Thus, likewise
, their
 spiritual offspring —
 the goods
,
 truths, and perceptions they
 bring
 forth — are far
 more abundant than the
 offspring
 of the
 present age. They passed
 through a
 longer interior
 gestation within
 the containing
 faculty
 of the
 will
 before
 coming
 forth
. Afterward
, many
 goods
 and truths issued
 from a single interior state. There were
 times when
 five distinct
 forms
 of
 good
 proceeded
 from a single interior reception
, and times when six proceeded
 from a single reception
 —
 sometimes
 fewer
,
 sometimes more. Because
 of this, the spiritual prog
eny of the will
 of
 the Most Ancient Church,
 and of its derivative
 fac
ulties, multipl
ied beyond
 measure. The natural
 mind was entirely
 furnished
 with goods and truths by
 reason
 of them alone,
 because the spiritual offspring of
 the ancient
 dispensation —
 what
 they brought forth into
 natural
 expression
 — differs
 utt
erly from what
 is brought
 forth today
.
 The
 manner in
 which interior
 tru
ths were
 conceived
 and brought into
 conscious
 existence in
 the earliest church bears
 no resemblance to the dimin
ished and
 external
 manner
 by
 which spiritual
 states
 are now received
 and born
 into
 the
 out
ward mind
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Now, no[te] that Adam is mighty in his stature, and great is his size. Even his years are many! He spent many years living in the world. And he is not the only one we have found to be mighty; but all the others who were begotten in his generation, many are their years too. Still, these people who are born today, their stature has been diminished in power; even their years are lessened. Also, why is the birth today, of [the]y who are born, altered compared with that of these first [generations? Have the stars shifted from] place to place? See, even the stars and signs of the zodiac continue in their positions. Why now have the age and the years of these last ones diminished, and he has also become smaller, compared to these ancient ones who belong to these first generations?

They increased, have turned, and diminished; because there are five types of authorities and leaders appointed in the sphere of zodiacal signs, and the heavens above it. They have names they are ca[lled] by: the first name is the year; the sec[on]d is the month; the third is the day; the fou[rth] is the hour; the fifth is the moment. Now, these five positions, and these five houses, exist in the sphere and the heavens. These places have five powers, and they are made masters over them. The master of the year exists; the master of the month exists; the master of the day exists; the master of the hour exists; the master of the moment exists. In turn one is above his companion; and in turn the one above is made the master over the one below him.

So, mankind is begotten, and [the ani]mals. They are born in these powers. And, thus, these powers have received authority since the beginning of creation till the end of the world. Now, in the beginning of the generations the powers who were masters over the years reigned. Therefore, because of this, the offspring born in their generations and their lifetime: their years were found to be greater. They attain a long life span in the generation of Adam, and [tha]t of Sethel his son, and that of the ones who came after him.

After they ceased to reign, namely the powers who are masters over the years; the powers who are masters over the months themselves reigned. Like the months, for they are less than the years; again this [is] also the case with the offspring w[ho were] born in them. Their life span is less [than the life span of the ones born] in the generation of the powers who master the years!

When the authority of the powers who master the months was completed; the powers of the days received authority after them. Therefore, like the days, for they are less than the months, this also is the case with the offspring who were born in them. Their life span is less than the life span of the ones born in the powers who are masters over the months. Again, even so the offspring who were born in the hours, and of the moments. Their {conduit} is less than that of the months and the days.
Now, can you recount to me this other (matter): By what sort of birth was the entire offspring of mankind made from one man and one woman, Adam and Eve?

For the manner of these first generations is that they are richer in their light and purer in stature. Even their years are greater. Thus, again, even their offspring is much more than the offspring of this tim[e]. They were spending a longer time [ ... ] in [the w]omb of their mother. Afterwards, they [ ... ] a number in a single womb. There are times five were brought forth from a single womb, and times six were brought forth from [a] single womb! There are some lesser than this; again, some greater than this. Indeed, because of this the offspring of Eve multiplied, and of her children. The earth was filled by reason of them alone; because the offspring from the generation of the people of old, who they bore into the world, differ greatly from those of today. Their conception and their birth is not like latter births, brought forth nowadays from the woman's uterus.
